description: Machine-readable long-term pricing policy for SHEIN ordinary marketing signup, coupon pairing, and limited-discount fallback. This file contains no credentials.

limitedDiscount.priorityNote: Limited discount is the guaranteed fallback price layer when ordinary marketing is not enough. Coupons are not guaranteed to trigger, so do not rely on ordinary marketing + 15% coupon as the primary guaranteed price stack; cancel/recreate or adjust limited discounts when the guaranteed base price would be lower or higher than the intended target.

exposureTopLinks.sourceNote: Top links are ranked globally per standard_goods_sn across all stores and all links. Ranking uses positive 7-day exposure first; only when a whole standard_goods_sn has no positive 7-day exposure does it fall back to 30-day/total exposure. Rows with no positive metric in the selected fallback tier are not used for top-link ranking; if exposure data is unavailable, scripts keep the base margin and mark the exposure rule as not applied.

limitedDiscount.activityNamePrefix: 新上架7天高曝光兜底限时折扣
limitedDiscount.ruleNote: 所有新上架7天内、尚未报过普通营销活动的在售链接，巡检到后立即按全局曝光Top5力度报一周限时折扣；已有旧限时折扣但不符合该力度/窗口的，安全取消后重报。

ordinaryMarketing.ruleNote: 新上架7天内链接首次进入新品/超级新品类普通营销活动时，也按全局曝光Top5力度定价，而不是普通链接力度。
